headline: Annual summary of activities and financial report, plus election of chair, vice chair, treasurer, and clerk.
summary: The agenda also includes an open item for other business. The notice says topics not listed may come up, and some listed items may not be discussed.
items: Review of annual summary of activities and financial report
Appointment of chairperson and vice chairperson
location: Holyoke City Hall - Room 6, 536 Dwight Street, Holyoke, MA

City of Holyoke

OCT 15 2026

Holyoke, MA

## Annual Meeting Notice and Agenda

Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
Holyoke City Hall - Room 6
536 Dwight Street, Holyoke, MA

Or join on Zoom:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88094595986?pwd=eUoBEh7kn3Lcr5TSkdnTFuax5ml6Bj.1
Webinar ID: 739398
Call in 1 (646) 558-8656 with same Webinar ID

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, notice is hereby given the Holyoke Economic Development and Industrial Corporation annual meeting. The meeting is being held in person and remotely according to the provisions of the Executive Order extended by Governor Healey on March 28, 2025. This meeting notice contains the link above providing the public with remote access.

The meeting is being recorded and matters listed on this agenda are those reasonably anticipated by the Chairperson which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.

1. Call to Order
2. Review of Annual Summary of Activities and Financial Report
3. Appointment of Chairperson and Vice Chairperson
4. Election of Treasurer and Clerk
5. Other Business
6. Adjournment

Eric Nakajima
Director
